cards.audioText: How does a SNOWTAM differ from other Notices to Airmen (NOTAMs)?
cards.audioTextZh: 雪情通告（SNOWTAM）与其他航行通告（NOTAM）有何不同？
cards.referenceText: A SNOWTAM is a special-series NOTAM used to report significant runway surface conditions involving standing water, snow, slush, ice or frost through the ICAO Global Reporting Format. It gives structured runway condition information, including the assessed condition of each runway third and other operationally important details. Other NOTAMs cover a much wider range of temporary changes or hazards, such as closed facilities, unserviceable aids or airspace restrictions.
cards.referenceTextZh: SNOWTAM 是一种特殊系列航行通告，用于按照 ICAO 全球报告格式报告涉及积水、雪、雪浆、冰或霜的重要跑道表面状况。它提供结构化的跑道状况信息，包括对跑道每三分之一段的评估结果和其他重要运行细节。其他航行通告涵盖更广泛的临时变化或危险，例如设施关闭、相关设施不可用或空域限制。
